en: Bet you don't want to hear that, either.
Are you keeping well?
Doing your cleaning?
...Write your family a letter now and then.
My work's nothing special.
But it's work the world needs, all the same.
Nothing in this world is unneeded, you know.
What, a peddler? Not interested.
Let me put my feet up at home, at least.
Pardon me, I wished to introduce myself...
I moved to London just recently, you see.
I see. I'm Agnes, pleased to meet you.
You picked a bad time. I'm busy now.
Sorry, if it's business, come another day.
Oh, you're the one from the other day...
What do you want with an old girl like me?
Oh,
note: Before the name (Agnes, Winifred, Sarah, Vanessa, villager 98): 'Oh, ' + name.

en: , is it?
note: After the name: 'Oh, Chris, is it?' (Agnes), 'Chris, is it?' (Madeline, name at line start), after #6578 (Claudia). Matches #6350.

en: Want to hire me to do some cleaning?
I don't work for free, mind. Hahahaha!
, back again, are you?
note: After the name at line start: 'Chris, back again, are you?'

en: You don't know anybody here, so you're lonely, eh?
Good to see you. Stay for a cup of tea?
Say, aren't you looking a bit tired?
I don't know what it's about, but
note: Joined on the same line with #6425 (trailing space).

en: don't rush things.
Why is this human so meddlesome?
What does she gain by caring for others?
Humans have the most unfathomable notions...
Sigh... What am I going to do with you?
A grown man, loafing about like this.
But I expect you've got your reasons.
Whenever you feel like talking, just say so.
A life of nothing but toiling like an insect.
Surely this is better than such a life
Become my servant, and live in the night
The day I strike down the one in my way draws near
Morning, you handsome young man!
Good morning. And you are...?
I'm Agnes. I'm a charwoman.
I'm just about to head off to work.
Up early too, good for you. Your work?
Oh, well, um...
I've only just come to London.
No wonder I didn't know your face.
There's a job agency to the southeast.
People have got to work, you know.
Thank you, I'll do that.
A morning walk? Good habit. It's good for you.
What's your name? I've forgotten.
You remembered me?
My name is
note: 'My name is ' + name + #473 '.'; Mike msg 304478/304629 uses #7830 (other slice).

en: I'd never forget a handsome man once I've seen him.
Up early again today. Good for you.
I don't know what you do for work, but
make sure you eat and sleep properly.
Thank you, Agnes.
I'll keep that in mind.
Good evening, madam.
"Madam," eh... You mean me?
You talk all fancy, like some nobleman.
But somehow it doesn't get my back up.
Evening. I'm Agnes.
Haven't seen your face before. From abroad?
Yes, something like that.
I moved to London just recently.
Yes, yes, pleased to meet you.
Nights are dangerous. Stop fooling about and go home.
A night owl, are you? Don't stay up too late.
Are you a student or something?
I hear you wander the town all day long.
You're young. That's no way to carry on.
Thank you for your concern.
But there is something I must do.
I see. Then I won't say any more.
Just don't overdo it. This town's dangerous.
Watch yourself, especially at night.
Understood, I will.
Young master, is it fun, watching me clean?
Care to join me? Cleaning. Ahahahaha!
